summary.result: Though yield criterion parameters ( h, ${\alpha}$ a) are much influenced by stress level and stress path, the parameters don't have influence on stress-strain behavior.
summary.background: To get accurate results, the realistic stress-strain relationships of soils are dependent on a number of factors such as soil types, density, stress levels and stress path.
summary.method: Using the computer program based on the regression analysis, the values of parameters for the model were determined.
